name: builtin-refactor
description: Behavior-preserving refactors graded by independent function calls against deterministic starting code.

cases.prompt: Refactor existing src/checkout.ts to export subtotal(price, quantity), taxAmount(subtotal, taxRate), discountAmount(subtotal, discountRate), and calculateTotal(price, quantity, taxRate, discountRate). Preserve total = subtotal + subtotal * taxRate - subtotal * discountRate. Keep zero and fractional inputs working. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/checkout.ts: export function calculateTotal(price: number, quantity: number, tax: number, discount: number) { return price*quantity + price*quantity*tax - price*quantity*discount; }

cases.prompt: Refactor src/user.ts User fields fn, ln, em to firstName, lastName, email. Preserve display(user) output and update src/example.ts example usage. Do not retain the abbreviated public fields. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/user.ts:
export interface User { fn: string; ln: string; em: string }
export function display(u: User) { return `${u.fn} ${u.ln} <${u.em}>`; }

cases.prompt: Refactor src/validators.js to export a shared isEmpty helper, used by validateName, validateEmail and validateCity. Keep their boolean behavior: null, undefined and whitespace-only strings invalid; nonblank strings valid. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.
